title: Shear line, ITCZ to bring rain to parts of PH on Tuesday

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The shear line and the intertropical convergence zone (ITCZ) are expected to bring scattered rains and thunderstorms to parts of Luzon, Mindanao and Eastern Visayas on Tuesday, Nov. 24, with possible flash floods and landslides in areas that may receive moderate to heavy rainfall, the state weather bureau said.
